label: PS-4(1)
title: Post-employment Requirements

children.label: (a)
children.prose: Notify terminated individuals of applicable, legally binding post-employment requirements for the protection of organizational information; and

children.label: (b)
children.prose: Require terminated individuals to sign an acknowledgment of post-employment requirements as part of the organizational termination process.

guidance: Organizations consult with the Office of the General Counsel regarding matters of post-employment requirements on terminated individuals.
